title: Bond Voyage! Organic Reactions
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B organic reactions five ways: Identify the Reaction, Draw the Product, Draw the Reactant, Name It, and Full Reaction (reactant, reaction type, product, then name). Students draw on a built-in pad with automatic hydrogens and a lasso tool, and can switch between skeletal, condensed, expanded, or mixed structures. Covers alkanes and alkenes; alcohols, aldehydes, and ketones; and carboxylic acids, esters, amines, and amides. Naming accepts common alternate names. Includes a pop-out reaction reference, hints, answer reveals, XP, streaks, medal badges, and a Dr. Dan video matched to each question.
